problem: AI Modelwijzer and AI Governance remained available as pages but had disappeared from canonical site navigation, making them hard to discover after the website/portal coherence recovery.
root_cause: The earlier recovery reverted canonical header/footer files to avoid static-i18n drift and restored AI discovery only inside the product proposition, not in the global Kennis navigation.
decision: Restore AI Modelwijzer and AI Governance to desktop/mobile Kennis navigation and the footer, with explicit fail-closed English translations.
prevention: Canonical navigation changes must preserve current AI discovery routes.
Header/footer route recovery must include desktop and mobile variants.
Any new canonical navigation copy must be added to the static English cache in the same change.
